subject: Cost and Management Accounting
question_text:
14.  In a factory, during the month of October 2025, the following transactions
have occurred in respect of purchase and issue of "Material A."

Material A

Stock on 01.10.2025, 100 units at ` 50 per unit

Purchases:

05-10-2025, 2,500 units at ` 55 per unit

08-10-2025, 600 units at ` 56 per unit

Issues:

15-10-2025, 1,500 units

What is the value of material A consumed during the period, using LIFO
method of pricing issues?
(A)  ` 83,100
(B)  ` 82,000
(C) ` 82,500
(D)  ` 84,000
(2 Marks)
